legacy_frame_joint_domain.proof:
by
  let d := Solidity.Backend.Selection.V2.duplicateHead 7
  let c : Solidity.Backend.Selection.FrameCertificate [7] [7,7] := {
    code := d.code
    frame := d.frame
    prefixes := by
      intro tail bound before after reached split ran
      apply Solidity.Backend.Scalar.prefix_capacity before after ran
      rw [split]
      exact bound }
  exact ⟨[7], [7,7], c, [11,99], True.intro⟩

legacy_prefixes_joint_domain.proof:
by
  let d := Solidity.Backend.Selection.V2.duplicateHead 7
  let c : Solidity.Backend.Selection.FrameCertificate [7] [7,7] := {
    code := d.code
    frame := d.frame
    prefixes := by
      intro tail bound before after reached split ran
      apply Solidity.Backend.Scalar.prefix_capacity before after ran
      rw [split]
      exact bound }
  exact ⟨[7], [7,7], c, [11,99], by decide, [], c.code, [7,11,99], rfl, rfl, True.intro⟩

instruction_success_joint_domain.proof:
by
  let value : Fin Solidity.Evm.W := ⟨7, by decide⟩
  exact ⟨.push (.val value), Solidity.Backend.Selection.literalCertificate value, [11], [7,11], { Solidity.Evm.Machine.init with stack := Solidity.Backend.Selection.irStack [11] }, rfl, True.intro⟩
